pricing.title: Pricing & Packages | Briefbox Digital
pricing.h1: Simple pricing for AI, marketing, content and web projects
pricing.desc: Briefbox Digital pricing: AI automation from $390, AI products from $99/mo, Meta and Google Ads from $390/mo, content and websites.
pricing.intro: Clear packages for every service, from a $149 ads audit to complete AI systems. One-time projects are paid 50% to start and 50% on delivery; monthly plans are billed in advance and can be cancelled with 30 days notice unless a minimum term is stated. Prices are in US dollars and exclude taxes such as VAT or sales tax.
pricing.note: Not included unless stated: ad spend, WhatsApp or Meta message fees, AI model usage, third-party software subscriptions, domains and stock images. These are paid by you directly or passed on at cost. Hosting of AI products on our n8n server is included in the monthly fee.
